MS in Management Sciences

2-Year Postgraduate Research Degree (30-36 Credit Hours)

Minimum Qualification

16 Years of Education in a business-related field (BBA 4-Year / BS Business Administration / B.Com 4-Year / MBA or equivalent)

Marks Benchmark: At least 50% Marks or CGPA 2.0/4.0 in relevant qualification
Specific Admission Rules:
  • Admission test: Minimum 50% cumulative score in University or authorized testing agency test
  • Alternative tests: Valid GRE (International) score >= 50% or GAT Subject score >= 60%
  • Merit calculation: 50% academic performance, 30% admission test, and 20% interview
  • Course selection: Minimum 4 Core Courses from core pool, maximum 5 Electives from specialization pool (contingent on teacher availability)
  • Provision of two-years extension available for research completion
02 Years (Provision of two-years extension)

Mandatory Documentation

Application Document Checklist (12 Items)

After filling out the online application at uoli.ac.pk/admissions, applicants must download & print the form, attach attested copies of the following mandatory documents, and submit the complete hardcopy dossier to the Admissions Office:

Secondary School Certificate (Matric / SSC)

Attested copy of Matriculation Certificate & DMC issued by a recognized BISE board.

Mandatory Submission
Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate)

Attested copy of Intermediate (FA / F.Sc / ICS / I.Com) Certificate & provisional certificate.

Mandatory Submission
Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC)

Attested copy of official Detailed Marks Certificate (DMC) of Intermediate showing marks breakdown.

Mandatory Submission
Applicant CNIC / Smart Card / B-Form

Attested copy of Computerized National Identity Card or Form-B for candidates under 18 years.

Mandatory Submission
Local / Domicile Certificate

Attested copy of District Local / Domicile certificate of Balochistan.

Mandatory Submission
Character Certificate

Attested character certificate issued by the principal/head of the last attended institution.

Mandatory Submission
Recent Passport-Size Photographs

6 recent passport-size photographs with blue background (applicant name written on back).

Mandatory Submission
Father / Guardian CNIC

Attested copy of Computerized National Identity Card of father or legal guardian.

Mandatory Submission
Migration Certificate

Original Migration Certificate (required for candidates from educational boards outside Balochistan / Quetta BISE).

Where Applicable
IBCC Equivalence Certificate

Equivalence certificate from Inter Board Committee of Chairmen (IBCC) for A-Levels, Sanvia-Khasa, or foreign credentials.

Where Applicable
Printed University Admission Form

Completed, printed, and signed copy of the online application form from the UOLi admission portal.

Download Blank Form (PDF)
Mandatory Submission
Original Bank Processing Fee Challan (ABL)

Original paid ABL bank challan receipt of application processing fee (Rs. 2,000 for BS/DPT/Allied/B.Ed, Rs. 3,000 for MS/PhD).

Mandatory Submission
University Regulations

Key Academic & Merit Policies

Program Change Policy

Change of academic program is generally discouraged. However, it may be permitted within the first 2 weeks of the 1st semester, subject to seat availability, Chairperson recommendation, Dean approval, and the condition that the applicant’s merit score is higher than the closing merit of the desired program.

Semester Freezing Policy

Freezing of a semester is strictly NOT permitted during the 1st semester. After completing the 1st semester, a student may apply to freeze a maximum of 2 semesters across the entire degree program duration.

Merit Weightage Formula

For Undergraduate BS Admissions, merit is calculated as: 20% Matriculation (SSC) + 50% Intermediate (HSSC) + 30% Entry Test / Interview Score.

Application Hardcopy Mailing Address

After completing online registration on our Admissions Portal, download & print the form, attach all 12 attested documents with original ABL fee challan, and send to: Admission Office, University of Loralai, Zerh Karez, Quetta Road, Loralai, Balochistan, Pakistan.
